message:
As we gather our loved ones and think about preparedness, it can be comforting to turn the task of building an emergency kit into a cozy little event. 🏡 

We can make it a fun afternoon—snacks, music, and a bit of brainstorming about what we might need to feel secure at home. Plus, it’s a great way to share stories and learn from each other. After all, being ready doesn’t have to be daunting; it can be a chance to strengthen our connections and ensure we’re all on the same page. 

What’s the first item you’d put in your kit?
